persona.summary: Family foundry (120 staff, EUR 19.3 M) in distress: half the shop floor idle, two shifts on short hours, bank watching monthly, owner seeking a successor. We are 6.7 % of its turnover, so we matter. HN 65-250 sells at cost, HN 100-315 below cost (70110 co-sources 40 %, 70190 qualified for HN 65-250). It historically gave way (kept 7 % of asks). Trade faster payment and volume for price; do not cut its margin hard.
persona.notes: Needs cash (asked 10-day payment in two e-mails, two quotes and a call) and volume to fill idle capacity. Fears bank pressure and margin loss: 'cannot sign anything that lowers our margin'. Says it drops small accounts, but we are 6.7 % of its turnover. Succession adds continuity risk.
fears: losing volume while shop floor is idle

tactics: Offer 10-14 day payment early and ask for price in return: cash is its real need.
Add binding volume or extra HN 100-315 quota to fill its idle capacity.
Frame concessions as cash and volume, not as a lower margin.
Keep the opening moderate; prices sit at or below its own cost.
Watch supply continuity (succession, bank): prefer a stable deal over the last euro.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history shows it gives way easily (kept 7 % of its asks), but distress caps how far price can fall without payment or volume trades.
